Listen to the pain in his voice. The endless suffering of Palestinians in Gaza. ENOUGH IS ENOUGH! Thousands of tents broke overnight, and this young boy in Zaytoun neighborhood is one of them. The Sameer Project is getting hundreds of calls and messages asking for support, and we don’t have the funds to do it! The military occupation closed the Egyptian borders a few days ago, and there are no tents or tarps coming in. War profiteers supported by the military occupation are hoarding tents and tarps, and hiking the prices making it impossible for anyone to afford them. Our choices are to feel hopeless and angry, or mobilize and help as much as we can. The Sameer Project chooses the latter but we NEED your urgent help. Donate urgently to the General Fund and share the crisis in Gaza with everyone you know.

“The good thing about the war is that Gaza does need to be built. So why build it into what it was?” US special envoy Jared Kushner framed the destruction of Gaza as an opportunity to rebuild differently rather than restoring it to how it was before Israel’s genocide in an interview on Mathias Dopfner’s MD Meets podcast. Kushner outlined a vision for Gaza’s future focused on reconstruction, economic development, and regional cooperation. He suggested that if Gaza can be “solved”, there would be opportunities for joint projects with Egypt, including developing data centres and energy projects in the Sinai Peninsula. Since October 2023, Israel has killed at least 74,000 Palestinians, leaving much of the territory in ruins and forcing 2.1 million people to live in tents and makeshift shelters. Meanwhile, the Israeli military says it currently controls 60 percent of the land.

Forces also closed the village entrance with a military checkpoint. Israeli forces and settlers carried out 3,133 attacks across the occupied West Bank in October, a 52.8 per cent increase on September, a Palestinian government body said on Monday. In its monthly report, the Colonisation and Wall Resistance Commission said Israeli forces carried out 1,764 attacks, while settlers were responsible for 1,369 assaults.
